name: t3-code
description: Launch, follow, steer, and stop T3 Code threads on the owner's main machine through its native MCP tools.

interface.longDescription: Use the native T3 Code MCP tools on your main machine: find projects, launch coding threads in a project, worktree, or scratch folder, wait for and read results, send follow-ups, answer questions, and interrupt runs. Work executes and persists in T3 Code on that machine; the machine must be online.
defaultPrompt: What T3 Code threads are running right now?
Start a T3 Code thread in my project to fix this bug.
Check on my last T3 Code thread and summarize the result.
